name: Automatic Pressure Holding Unit
summary: Apply and maintain constant pressure on assembled components to ensure bonding or assembly process quality. Precise pressure control with extended pressure-holding duration.
contentHtml:
The automatic pressure-holding unit is an automated device developed by TXAM for bonding processes.

Working Principle

The equipment applies constant pressure to products that have completed processes such as dispensing and lamination, ensuring the adhesive is fully cured and assembly quality remains stable and consistent.

Technical Advantages

  • Precise pressure control, ensuring bonding quality
  • Long pressure-holding time, adapting to different process requirements
  • High adaptability, compatible with a variety of products
  • Automated operation, reducing manual intervention
